evidence_records:
record_id: A125-E02
title: 显色克隆的发生频率与跨导管分散
sample_keys: 
  [1] S01
groups:

    finding: Supplementary Fig. 4报告每乳腺标记事件总数1.49±0.92；小、中、大区域分开。大区域不等同于推定MaSC克隆，后者另为约0.03±0.06/乳腺。 所列±均为作者报告的SD。

    group_ids: 
      [1] A125-E02-G01

      unit: labelling events per gland
      error_type: SD
      mice: 9
      small: 
        approx_cells: 2–5
        mean: 0.57
        sd: 0.69
      moderate: 
        approx_cells: 5–50
        mean: 0.82
        sd: 0.27
      large: 
        cells: >50
        mean: 0.1
        sd: 0.08
      total: 
        mean: 1.49
        sd: 0.92
      presumptive_MaSC_subset: 
        mean: 0.03
        sd: 0.06
      gland_count_for_this_9_mouse_analysis: null (as recorded in source)
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F03
        location: PDF p4, Supplementary Fig. 4 table and legend
        url: https://media.springernature.com/original/springer-static/esm/art%3A10.1038%2Fncomms13053/MediaObjects/41467_2016_BFncomms13053_MOESM370_ESM.pdf
        source_status: verified_in_scoped_reading
    limitations: 
      [1] 近似区域大小类别在约5细胞边界重叠，照原文保留，不重新定义。
      [2] Methods一般写每鼠8腺，但此9鼠分析图注没有显式列出总腺数，不把72当直接报告。
    question_ids: 
      [1] A125-GQ03
  [2]     observation_id: A125-E02-O02
    finding: 30鼠、240乳腺中汇总8个大标记区。标记细胞沿多个分支散布且与未标记细胞相混；不等于整段导管由单一祖细胞占满。
    evidence_type: reported_observation
    group_ids: 
      [1] A125-E02-G01
    result: 
      mice: 30
      glands: 240
      presumptive_large_clones: 8
      clone_table: 
        [1]           id: BP.1
          length_mm: >8
          branches: >18
          distance_from_origin_mm: >3
        [2]           id: BP.2
          length_mm: ~5
          branches: >10
          distance_from_origin_mm: >1
        [3]           id: BP.3
          length_mm: >4
          branches: >15
          distance_from_origin_mm: >5
        [4]           id: BP.4
          length_mm: >3
          branches: >12
          distance_from_origin_mm: >1
        [5]           id: BP.5
          length_mm: ~3
          branches: >19
          distance_from_origin_mm: >1
        [6]           id: BP.6
          length_mm: ~4
          branches: >9
          distance_from_origin_mm: >3
        [7]           id: BP.7
          length_mm: >9
          branches: >20
          distance_from_origin_mm: 0
        [8]           id: BP.8
          length_mm: ~3
          branches: >7
          distance_from_origin_mm: >4
          panel_b_distance_label: >7
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F02
        location: Fig. 2b–d table
        url: https://www.nature.com/articles/ncomms13053
        source_status: verified_in_scoped_reading
      [2]         source_id: F03
        location: PDF p5, Supplementary Fig. 5
        url: https://media.springernature.com/original/springer-static/esm/art%3A10.1038%2Fncomms13053/MediaObjects/41467_2016_BFncomms13053_MOESM370_ESM.pdf
        source_status: verified_in_scoped_reading
    limitations: 
      [1] BP.8表内距离下界>4 mm，图b标>7 mm；二者下界不同但并非逻辑矛盾，均保留。
      [2] 8个大区的纳入不是全部标记事件，也不是8只独立动物。
    question_ids: 
      [1] A125-GQ03
      [2] A125-GQ04
  [3]     observation_id: A125-E02-O03
    finding: BP.7是形态学例外：相连但不同导管分支表现为腔面样或基底样标记。它从乳头区起始，作者推测可能来自早期、甚至胚胎期双能祖细胞；实际标记时间及其共同祖先并未直接观测。
    evidence_type: observed_morphology_with_author_interpretation
    group_ids: 
      [1] A125-E02-G01

      marker_confirmed_bipotency: false

Application.Text14:
protocol_records:
record_id: A125-P002
title: 荧光报告乳腺 wholemount 免疫标记与 SeeDB 清除
record_type: partially_reported_workflow
purpose: 保留 native stroma 内荧光克隆和谱系标记，供 3D 成像。
applicability: 
  scope: 按样本/图面/分支限定，见 cases 和 E/G/O mapping。
start_state: 指定模型/时期的离体乳腺；基因模型构建不在本清除记录中展开。
end_state: 115% w/v 果糖中已标记的透明乳腺。
provenance: 
  source: 本轮实读原始 article.xml Methods/Results/captions 和补充 PDF
  legacy_protocol_rows: 
[]
materials: 
  [1] NBF; PBS; Triton X-100; BSA
  [2] primary/secondary antibody catalogue: P002-S03/S04
  [3] DAPI 10 µM
  [4] fructose and α-thioglycerol
preparation_and_warnings: 
  [1] 该记录按来源恢复已报告动作，不补造缺失条件；不是实验执行批准。
sections: 
  [1]     section_id: A125-P002-SEC01
    title: 固定与 wholemount 免疫标记
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A125-P002-S01
        title: 取材与一般固定
        action: 使用报告模型在指定生理阶段的乳腺。每鼠取除第一对颈部乳腺以外的 8 个乳腺；一般固定条件为 10% NBF、室温 9 h，处理组织块约 15×15×2 mm。
        parameters: 
          glands_per_mouse: 8
          excluded_glands: first cervical pair
          fixative: 10% NBF
          duration: 9 h
          temperature: RT
          piece_dimensions: ~15 × 15 × 2 mm
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Animal models
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[1]
            checked_this_round: true
          [2]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Optical tissue clearing and wholemount immunostaining
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[4]
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 切块与固定的具体相对顺序未明；不继承显色路线 4 h 初固定与其后固定。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [2]         step_id: A125-P002-S02
        title: 封闭与通透
        action: 在含 Triton X-100 与 BSA 的 PBS 中于 4 °C 过夜封闭/通透。
        parameters: 
          Triton_X100: 1%
          BSA: 10%
          vehicle: PBS
          duration: overnight
          temperature: 4 °C
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Optical tissue clearing and wholemount immunostaining
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[4]
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 两种百分比的质量/体积基准、用量未报告。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [3]         step_id: A125-P002-S03
        title: wholemount 一抗
        action: 按实际图面选择一抗，在封闭液中稀释并轻摇孵育 4 天。
        parameters: 
          diluent: blocking buffer
          duration: 4 days
          temperature: 4 °C
          agitation: gentle rocking
          primary_catalogue: 
            [1]               target: K5
              host: rabbit
              supplier_cat: Covance PRB160P
              dilution: 1:100
            [2]               target: K8
              host: rat
              supplier_cat: DSHB TROMA-I
              dilution: 1:50
            [3]               target: SMA
              host: rabbit
              supplier_cat: Abcam ab5694
              dilution: 1:300
            [4]               target: SMA
              host: mouse
              supplier_cat: Abcam ab7817
              dilution_as_printed: 1;200
            [5]               target: E-cadherin
              host: rabbit
              supplier_cat: Cell Signaling 3195
              dilution: 1:50
            [6]               target: PR
              host: rabbit
              supplier_cat: DAKO A0098
              dilution: 1:50
            [7]               target: GFP
              host: chicken
              supplier_cat: Abcam ab13970
              dilution: 1:2000
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Optical tissue clearing and wholemount immunostaining
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[4]
            checked_this_round: true
          [2]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Reagents
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[3]
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 试剂目录不是全部抗体同时混合；具体共染组合按图面。mouse anti-SMA 印刷分隔符为分号，保留原样，不能以此创建第二种浓度。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [4]         step_id: A125-P002-S04
        title: 洗涤与二抗
        action: 清洗后，在 4 °C 孵育对应荧光二抗 2 天。
        parameters: 
          secondary_dilution: 1:500
          duration: 2 days
          temperature: 4 °C
          catalogue: 
            [1] goat anti-mouse 488 A11001
            [2] goat anti-mouse 647 A21237
            [3] goat anti-rat Cy3 A10522
            [4] goat anti-rat 488 A11006
            [5] goat anti-rabbit 488 A11008
            [6] goat anti-rabbit 647 A21245
            [7] goat anti-chicken 488 A11039
            [8] goat anti-chicken 568 A11041
          supplier: Life Technologies as reported
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Optical tissue clearing and wholemount immunostaining
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[4]
            checked_this_round: true
          [2]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Reagents
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[3]
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 洗液、清洗次数/时长、二抗稀释液和具体每面板二抗组合未报告；不从 catalogue 任意配对形成新组合。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [5]         step_id: A125-P002-S05
        title: 清洗与 DAPI
        action: 再次清洗后，DAPI 孵育 1–2 h。
        parameters: 
          DAPI: 10 µM
          duration: 1–2 h
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Optical tissue clearing and wholemount immunostaining
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[4]
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 洗液/次数/时长，DAPI 温度与稀释液未报告；不继承二抗的 4 °C。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
  [2]     section_id: A125-P002-SEC02
    title: 果糖透明化
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A125-P002-S06
        title: SeeDB 果糖递增系列
        action: 将组织依次置于蒸馏水配制的 20%、40%、60%、80%（w/v）果糖溶液。原文该 serial-incubation 句给出 8–16 h、室温和 2–3 ml；保留时间适用范围的原表达。
        parameters: 
          fructose_series: 
            [1] 20% w/v
            [2] 40% w/v
            [3] 60% w/v
            [4] 80% w/v
          solvent: distilled water
          reported_duration: 8–16 h
          temperature: RT
          volume: 2–3 ml
          alpha_thioglycerol: 0.5% in all fructose solutions
          agitation: gentle agitation
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Optical tissue clearing and wholemount immunostaining
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[4]
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 原句没有单列 each；不计算该系列总时长或把各级时间展开成已确认的总和。α-thioglycerol 的百分比基准未报告。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [2]         step_id: A125-P002-S07
        title: 终末果糖阶段
        action: 随后转入 100%（w/v）果糖 24 h，再转入 115%（w/v）果糖 24 h 或直至成像；全部果糖液含 α-thioglycerol 并轻柔振荡。
        parameters: 
          fructose_100: 100% w/v, 24 h
          fructose_115: 115% w/v, 24 h or until imaged
          alpha_thioglycerol: 0.5%
          agitation: gentle agitation
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Optical tissue clearing and wholemount immunostaining
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[4]
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 后两级的体积、温度没有在该句重复指定；RT/2–3 ml 不作为单独再次确认的条件。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
cases: 
  [1]     case_id: A125-P002-C01
    title: 青春期 EYFP 样本
    parameters: 
      model: hemizygous R26[CA]30EYFP
      stage: female virgin, 7 weeks
      label_origin: continuous stochastic reporter labelling; exact label time unknown
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F01
        path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
        locator: Methods > Animal models
        xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[1]
        checked_this_round: true
  [2]     case_id: A125-P002-C02
    title: Confetti 样本来源与观察时点
    parameters: 
      model: R26-Confetti;R26-CreERT2, hemizygous for both
      reported_induction_history: single 1 mg tamoxifen intraperitoneal injection in sunflower oil at 28 days
      initial_label_collection: 2-day chase
      puberty_collection: 3-week chase
      lineage_labelling: Results describes K8 or SMA plus DAPI; original Fig.5b overlay explicitly labels K5; Supplementary Fig.11b labels K8 and Fig.11c shows K8/SMA by panel.
      CFP_scope: underrepresented and not analysed
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F01
        path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
        locator: Methods > Induction of lineage tracing
        xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[2]
        checked_this_round: true
      [2]         source_id: F01
        path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
        locator: Methods > Animal models
        xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[1]
        checked_this_round: true
      [3]         source_id: F01
        path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
        locator: Figure 5 caption
        checked_this_round: true
      [4]         source_id: F03
        path: A125_candidate/sources/figure5.jpg
        locator: Fig.5b image channel legend
        source_raw: GFP/YFP/RFP/K5
        checked_this_round: true
        visual_read_this_round: true
      [5]         source_id: F02
        path: A125_candidate/sources/supplementary_information.pdf
        locator: PDF p.11 original image channel legends
        source_raw: Supplementary Fig.11b: GFP/YFP/RFP/K8; Fig.11c: SMA or K8 panels
        checked_this_round: true
        visual_read_this_round: true
    warning: 这是原研究样本前史与真实互斥取材分支；2 天/3 周不是清除孵育时长。无外部基因构建、病毒或新实验设计。
  [3]     case_id: A125-P002-C03
    title: 泌乳 EYFP 样本
    parameters: 
      model: R26[CA]30EYFP females mated with C57Bl/6J studs
      collection: lactation days 2–4
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F01
        path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml

        xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[1]
        checked_this_round: true
      [2]         source_id: F01
        path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
        locator: Figure 6 caption
        checked_this_round: true
  [4]     case_id: A125-P002-C04
    title: 阴性对照
    parameters: 
      control: no primary antibody controls
      samples: virgin and lactating tissues
      panel: Supplementary Fig.2
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F02

        locator: PDF p.2, Supplementary Fig.2
        checked_this_round: true
    warning: 省略相应一抗；替代缓冲液停留时长和各对照的全部处理条件未报告。

    source: F01 clearing Methods
  [6]     before: A125-P002-S06

Application.Text15:
protocol_records:
record_id: A125-P003
title: SeeDB 逆清除后的石蜡切片与二维免疫染色
record_type: partially_reported_workflow
purpose: 为 EYFP 克隆的二维谱系判读提供实体切片。
applicability: 
  scope: 按样本/图面/分支限定，见 cases 和 E/G/O mapping。
start_state: 已做 SeeDB 及 wholemount 成像的 R26[CA]30EYFP 乳腺。
end_state: K8/GFP/SMA 与 DAPI 标记的 6 µm 切片。
provenance: 
  source: 本轮实读原始 article.xml Methods/Results/captions 和补充 PDF
  legacy_protocol_rows: 
[]
materials: 
  [1] PBS
  [2] alcohol/xylene; paraffin
  [3] trisodium citrate 10 mM pH 6.0
  [4] goat serum; Triton X-100
  [5] K8/GFP/SMA antibodies and corresponding secondaries
  [6] DAPI 5 µM
preparation_and_warnings: 
  [1] 该记录按来源恢复已报告动作，不补造缺失条件；不是实验执行批准。
sections: 
  [1]     section_id: A125-P003-SEC01
    title: 逆清除与切片
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A125-P003-S01
        title: 逆转 SeeDB
        action: 已成像的 R26[CA]30EYFP 乳腺在 PBS 中 4 °C 过夜，以逆转 SeeDB 清除。
        parameters: 
          medium: PBS
          duration: overnight
          temperature: 4 °C
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Histology and two-dimensional immunostaining
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[6]
            checked_this_round: true
          [2]             source_id: F02
            path: A125_candidate/sources/supplementary_information.pdf
            locator: PDF p.10, Supplementary Fig.10
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 没有报告更换次数与体积。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [2]         step_id: A125-P003-S02
        title: 石蜡处理与实体切片
        action: 按作者所称常规酒精/二甲苯程序处理并包埋，切 6 µm 石蜡切片。
        parameters: 
          processing: standard alcohol and xylene paraffin processing/embedding
          section_thickness: 6 µm
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Histology and two-dimensional immunostaining
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[6]
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 脱水/透明/浸蜡的浓度、时长、温度缺失；不补标准 SOP。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [3]         step_id: A125-P003-S03
        title: 脱蜡与抗原修复
        action: 以二甲苯脱蜡，随后在 trisodium citrate 缓冲液中煮沸修复。
        parameters: 
          de_wax: xylene
          retrieval_buffer: 10 mM tri-sodium citrate, pH 6.0
          retrieval: boiling, 11 min
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Histology and two-dimensional immunostaining
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[6]
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 脱蜡时长及复水程序未报告。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
  [2]     section_id: A125-P003-SEC02
    title: 切片免疫染色
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A125-P003-S04
        title: 切片封闭
        action: 以 goat serum/PBST 在室温封闭 1 h。
        parameters: 
          goat_serum: 5%
          vehicle: PBS supplemented with 0.05% Triton X-100
          duration: 1 h
          temperature: RT
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Histology and two-dimensional immunostaining
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[6]
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 百分比基准未报告。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [2]         step_id: A125-P003-S05
        title: 切片一抗
        action: 以切片专用稀释度孵育一抗过夜。
        parameters: 
          temperature: 4 °C
          duration: overnight
          rat_anti_K8: 1:200
          chicken_anti_GFP: 1:2000
          rabbit_anti_SMA: 1:200
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Histology and two-dimensional immunostaining
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[6]
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 切片条件与 wholemount K8 1:50、rabbit SMA 1:300 不互换；稀释液和体积未报告。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [3]         step_id: A125-P003-S06
        title: 切片二抗与核复染
        action: 用 1:500 二抗，并以 5 µM DAPI 复染细胞核。
        parameters: 
          secondary: 1:500
          DAPI: 5 µM
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Histology and two-dimensional immunostaining
            xpath: body/sec[title="Methods"]/sec[6]
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 二抗身份逐切片组合、洗液、孵育时长/温度及封片条件未报告。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
cases: 
[]
reported_precedence: 
  [1]     before: A125-P003-S01
    after: A125-P003-S02
    source: F01 histology Methods
  [2]     before: A125-P003-S02
    after: A125-P003-S03
    source: F01 histology Methods
  [3]     before: A125-P003-S03
    after: A125-P003-S04
    source: F01 histology Methods
  [4]     before: A125-P003-S04
    after: A125-P003-S05
    source: F01 histology Methods
  [5]     before: A125-P003-S05
    after: A125-P003-S06
    source: F01 histology Methods
missing_information: 
  [1] 这是部分报告的石蜡方法，缺失的常规步骤不补造。

[]

Application.Text16:
protocol_records:
record_id: A125-P004
title: 荧光成像、3D 分割及独立二维/腺泡读出
record_type: readout_and_analysis_procedures
purpose: 生成按具体克隆、图像或细胞层级限定的图像与统计输出。
applicability: 
  scope: wholemount SeeDB 图像；其中二维计数单独接 P003，不能视为同一采集分支。
start_state: P002 透明组织、已有荧光图像栈，或 P003 染色实体切片。
end_state: 重建/分割、谱系分类、体积比、K8 分布比较及各自手工计数。
provenance: 
  source: F01 Confocal microscopy and image analysis/Statistics; original figures; F02
  legacy_protocol_rows: 
[]
materials: 
  [1] Leica TCS SP8; HC PL APO 10×/0.4 or 20×/0.75
  [2] Imaris v8.0; MATLAB/R2014a for KS; CImg Deriche
  [3] ImageJ v1.50a Cell Counter
preparation_and_warnings: 
  [1] 已有图像可直接进入对应处理分支，不重复清除和采集。
  [2] 荧光 overview mapping 图的设备/曝光未明确，不因邻接 confocal 图而继承其全部设置。
  [3] Figs.2a/5a/7 是模型示意，不是独立显微采集。
sections: 
  [1]     section_id: A125-P004-SEC01
    title: 采集与预处理
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A125-P004-S01
        title: wholemount 共聚焦采集
        action: 对 SeeDB 标记乳腺进行 SP8 共聚焦采集。按来源可用的两种物镜取像，逐荧光团手动调整激光功率、线平均和步进，以获得信号并尽量减少光漂白；原文未给具体数值。
        parameters: 
          instrument: Leica TCS SP8 inverted confocal
          objectives: 
            [1] 10×/0.4 HC PL APO
            [2] 20×/0.75 HC PL APO
          manual_settings: 
            [1] laser power
            [2] line averaging
            [3] step increment
          depth_reference: top of epithelial structure being imaged
          native_fat_pad_before_epithelium: typically ~350 µm
          routine_depth_through_tissue: 350–500 µm
        source_refs: 
          [1]             source_id: F01
            path: A125_candidate/sources/article.xml
            locator: Methods > Confocal microscopy and image analysis
            checked_this_round: true
        missing_information: 
          [1] 各面板使用哪种物镜、激发/发射设置、具体步距和曝光未报告；不把 350 µm 或图中 z 数字当作 acquisition z-step。
        legacy_rows: 
[]
      [2]         step_id: A125-P004-S02
        title: 重建、去噪和图像纳入
